deadline.value: December 15: all materials incl. test scores must be received. Year inferred.
deadline.quote: All required application materials and supporting documents must be submitted online and received by Cornell no later than December 15.

gre_subject.value: REQUIRED for theory applicants (theoretical astro, particle, condensed matter); theory applications without it cannot be considered
gre_subject.quote: The physics GRE is required for applicants with interests in theoretical physics, which includes theoretical astrophysics, theoretical elementary particle physics, and theoretical condensed matter physics. Theory applications without a physics GRE score cannot be considered for admission.

funding.value: 6 years of full support in good standing (fellowships, TA, RA)
funding.quote: We provide 6 years of full financial support for all graduate students in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's (or equivalent international degree) required; terminal master's applicants fully considered
entry_route.quote: A Bachelor's degree is required at the time of matriculation. | Applicants who have completed or are finishing a terminal Master's degree program will be given full consideration.

fee_waiver.value: Can be requested for financial hardship or extenuating circumstances (Graduate School criteria)
fee_waiver.quote: An application fee waiver can be requested in the event of financial hardship or extenuating circumstances.

toefl_min.value: No overall minimum stated; section minimums Speaking 23, Reading 20, Listening 15, Writing 20 (pre-2026) or 4.5/4/3.5/4 (new scale)
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL iBT score requirements for exams taken before January 2026 are: Speaking: 23, Reading: 20, Listening: 15, Writing: 20.

notes: Applied Physics (AEP) is a separate Cornell field with different GRE rules.
